newsitem.title: USA: Shoe Carnival names president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Shoe Carnival names president, CEO.

text.p: Shoe Carnival Inc said Thursday it named Mark Lemond, chief financial officer and chief operating officer, as president and chief executive officer.
Lemond replaces David Russell, who was appointed to the newly created office of vice chairman.
W. Kerry Jackson, controller and chief accounting officer, has been named to succeed Lemond as chief financial officer.

"David Russell created the spirit and energy of the Shoe Carnival concept. However, due to health reasons David can no longer maintain his former day-to-day pace of running this business," Wayne Weaver, chairman.
The company said Russell opened his first store in Evansville in 1978. Under Russell's leadership, the business has grown to 93 stores with an annual sales in excess of $225.0 million.
